concepts.label: Analytics Settings REST API
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a genuinely different endpoint (GET/POST /settings/analytics on the Cluster administration REST port, 8091/18091) from the other Analytics REST surfaces already extracted this round (config, library, service - all on port 8095/18095). The page itself states the port distinction: 'The port numbers for this REST API are different to the port numbers used by the other Analytics REST APIs.' Checked against analytics:service-level-configuration-parameter/node-specific-configuration-parameter (round 21/this round's config page) - those are the /analytics/config/* Service and Node objects on 8095; this is the separate /settings/analytics cluster-level endpoint on 8091, so not a duplicate.

notable_absence.finding: Unlike the sibling analytics-rest-config page (where a service-level or node-specific PUT requires a subsequent Node/Cluster Restart API call to take effect), this Settings API's numReplicas change requires a rebalance instead - the page never mentions restart at all for this setting, only rebalance. The two 'takes effect after X' mechanisms are kept distinct rather than merged.

cross_component_finding: This is the only one of the four analytics-rest-* pages read this round (admin/library/service/settings) whose host port is 8091/18091 (the shared cluster-administration port that every Couchbase service exposes) rather than the Analytics-specific 8095/18095 - the page states this explicitly as a deliberate distinction ('The port numbers for this REST API are different to the port numbers used by the other Analytics REST APIs'), and its security model is correspondingly generic ('Cluster Read / Pools Read') rather than an Analytics-specific gate.
cross_product_finding: None found on this page - it is a small, self-contained cluster-setting API with no Capella or other-product parallel stated.
